faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES Assistant Manager position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and make the fee payment is 08 October 2026. Candidates are urged to apply well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering to be eligible for the Assistant Manager (Civil Engineer / Airports) position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any work experience required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 2 years' experience in Airport planning, design of Airfield pavements, and preparation of detailed estimates is required for the Assistant Manager role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Manager post is 32 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How much is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates are required to pay Rs. 600/- plus applicable taxes as the application fee. This fee must be paid online.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the RITES Assistant Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by Document Scrutiny, and finally an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Manager post will receive a salary in the pay scale of INR 40,000 to INR 1,40,000.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, this recruitment is open for candidates across India. The job location is not restricted to a specific city or state.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the RITES Assistant Manager job?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates need to apply online through the RITES official website. The application link and detailed instructions are provided in the 'How to Apply' and 'Important Links' sections.

faq.question: Q10. Will there be any relaxation in the upper age limit for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years over and above the maximum age limit prescribed for the post.
